TerritoryBlock.description: TerritoryBlock groups zones for one territory profile and supplies their shared display color for Central Economy tooling.

color.description: Color is the ARGB color used to display this territory in tooling.

zone.description: Zones are circular spawn areas used by territory behaviors.

TerritoryFile.description: TerritoryFile defines named spawn zones used by territory profiles in `cfgenvironment.xml`.

territory.description:
Territories defines zone positions and static and dynamic entity count
limits for territory behaviors.

territory-type.description: XMLName identifies the required `<territory-type>` document root.

TerritoryZone.description: TerritoryZone defines one circular spawn area and its static and dynamic entity count limits.

dmax.description:
DMax is the upper bound for the dynamic entity count in this zone.
For an ambient event, its global max can still cap the count across all zones.

dmin.description:
DMin is the lower bound for the dynamic entity count in this zone.
For ambient spawners, the count is chosen from DMin through DMax, inclusive, when the zone activates.

name.description: Name identifies the zone for references and diagnostics.

r.description: R is the radius of the area where the zone's entities may spawn, in meters.

smax.description: SMax is the upper bound for the static entity count when the territory behavior supports static spawning.

smin.description: SMin is the lower bound for the static entity count when the territory behavior supports static spawning.

x.description: X is the map's horizontal X coordinate for the center of the zone.

z.description: Z is the map's horizontal Z coordinate for the center of the zone.
